Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (specifically Co-IP) to determine the interactome of AGT1 isoforms. Label-free quantification was performed via spectral counting.

scope: Co-immunoprecipitation was performed using the Pierce™ Co-Immunoprecipitation Kit

Two milligrams of soluble cell lysate from untransfected (negative control) or transfected cells (AGT-Ma and AGT-Mi) were incubated with 10 μg of polyclonal anti-AGT primary antibody, immobilized on column
The samples were eluted from the column using SDS buffer
After immunoprecipitation, the protein eluates were precipitated overnight with ice-cold acetone (1:4 v/v) and subjected to sample preparation for proteomics

interactome of two polymorphic forms of alanine:glyoxylate aminotransferase (AGT), the major allele, AGT-Ma and the minor one AGT-Mi. Theproteins were expressed in HEK293 cells and the interactome was analysed using co-immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry (IP-MS)

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material affinity-purified via co-immunoprecipitation of AGT1 isoforms from HEK293 cell lysates.
